name.ja: 確率的速度リスケーリング（CSVR）

note.ja: 正準方程式と分離可能なHamiltonianの代表形。調和・4次ポテンシャルの振動子で、エネルギー誤差とシンプレクティック性を比べます。
note.en: Canonical equations and a representative separable Hamiltonian. Harmonic and quartic oscillators distinguish energy error from symplecticity.

name.en: Scalar Ito diffusion: GBM and OU

note.ja: 決定論的初期値のスカラーSDE。平均・二次モーメントの弱誤差、共有Brown運動での強誤差、有限標本のMCSEを分けます。OUは調和Langevin系の浴成分に関連する追加検査です。
note.en: Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system.

note.ja: 著者作成の分割でありLAMMPS/MKT実装の完全再現ではありません。時刻20は混合・平衡化の証明でなく、平均温度一致だけで正準分布や一般的なエルゴード性を認定しません。
note.en: This authored splitting is not a full LAMMPS/MKT reproduction. Time20does not prove mixing/equilibration; correct mean temperature alone does not establish canonical sampling or general ergodicity.

name.ja: 固定線形拘束の正準運動量
name.en: Canonical momentum under fixed linear constraints

note.ja: 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
note.en: These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

name.ja: 拘束・重心除去と正準統計

caption.ja: 有効自由度、運動量共分散、過渡分布と時間相関を分けて検証します。 固定線形拘束の小例です。非線形分子拘束、Fixman補正、輸送係数へ一般化しません。独立seedの冗長拘束系には軌跡の一致を要求せず、CSVRの動的相関は経験的な結果です。
caption.en: Separate effectiveDOF,momentum covariance,transient distributions and time correlations. These fixed linear constraints do not cover nonlinear molecular constraints,Fixman corrections or transport coefficients. Redundant systems with independent seeds need not have identical paths; CSVR dynamical correlations are empirical.

note.ja: 質量重み付き接空間でLangevin/CSVRをOBABO分割します。初期正準共分散からの有限時刻写像・雑音共分散を直接組み、連続参照と離散定常Lyapunov解を別に求めます。
note.en: Apply tangent-space Langevin/CSVR in OBABO form. Build finite-time maps and noise covariance from canonical initial data; compute continuous references and stationary discrete Lyapunov solutions separately.

note.ja: 正準Gaussian・Gamma分布とK/U/Hの平均・分散を照合。有限刻みではVerletのshadow二次形式を使い、位置分散T/[ω²(1−h²ω²/4)]、運動量分散Tを別導出したLyapunov解と比較します。h=0.2/0.1/0.05の決定論的偏りで2次性を確認。Langevinのq,p,K,H相関は独立の離散伝播と照合し、CSVRの相関は独立複製の標準誤差とτ・h依存を表示します。
note.en: Check canonical Gaussian/Gamma distributions and K/U/H means/variances. For finite steps, compare the Verlet-shadow position variance T/[omega²(1−h² omega²/4)] and momentum variance T against a separately constructed Lyapunov solution. Deterministic biases at h=0.2/0.1/0.05 establish second order. Check Langevin q,p,K,H correlations against independent discrete propagation; report CSVR correlations with independent-replica standard errors and tau/h dependence.

note.ja: 座標の正規化・CDF・Uの平均/分散を1D求積、HのCDFをKの指数分布と2D座標Boltzmann密度の畳込み積分で得ます。求積公差2e−10と2e−12の差を保存し、独立棄却集団でもH分布を検査。q,p,K,Hの相関には複製間の標準誤差を併記し、刻み差と標本誤差を混同しません。
note.en: Obtain coordinate normalizers/CDFs and U moments by 1D quadrature, and the H CDF by convolving exponential K with the 2D positional Boltzmann density. Save the difference between quadrature tolerances 2e−10 and 2e−12; a separate rejection ensemble also checks H. Report independent-replica standard errors for q,p,K,H correlations, keeping step differences distinct from sampling noise.

note.en: Semi-analytic reference Fix unit masses,kBT1,frequencies1/1.7 and quartic0/.2. Compare NH1,NHC3,Berendsen and fixed-speed baths at two couplings/two steps with256canonical and128heated replicas. Dimensionless, unit masses, kBT=1, frequencies 1/1.7; Q1=2tau², Qj=tau². Two-mode initial-value problem without spatial boundaries; fixed canonical/heated ensembles. Same two-mode quartic system plus a harmonic control; short-time and finite-sample deterministic-bath comparisons.
